description: Create a material as the active Coach-Token owner only; staff credentials denied. payload follows POST /api/materials/: explicit stable slug required, title/description/slugs/cover_alt ru/en maps, parts [{type:TEXT,description:{ru/en:text}}], tags, localized covers supported. For a native AUDIO part supply type:AUDIO, title:{ru/en:text}, file_name and file_base64 (raw base64 or data URI), with optional description/order. To attach validated MP3 audio to an existing own draft part use online_article_audio_set. Defaults to private inactive draft. Set publish:true only after approval. is_active must match publish. Slug conflict: list/get before retry; never duplicate. Returns ID, revision, publication flags and URLs.
name: online_article_create
